statement: Eliminate repeated O(M) position scans of oversized CDC entries in composeCdcShipRange by reading entry owed byte totals in SQLite (SELECT_OWED_ENTRY_BYTES / readOwedCdcEntryBytes) and streaming per-ordinal units from first.ordinal - 1 without buffering the entire entry, page firstReadyRow position scans by DRIVE_PAGE_ROWS instead of single-row queries, and use readOwedCdcObligationPositions in drainPendingHydratedObligations so hydrated-prefix acknowledgement never reads event_json payloads while preserving S-12 shipping-unit and S-13 single-cut-authority invariants.

constraints.statement: Shipping one event from an oversized Raft entry (entry owed bytes > SHIP_MAX_BYTES) executes a constant O(1) number of SQLite read queries per wave (<= 4 queries across 512, 1024, and 4096 owed events in a single entry) by querying SELECT_OWED_ENTRY_BYTES in SQLite and starting owedEntriesFrom at first.ordinal - 1 with per-ordinal unit streaming when isOversizedEntry(db, row) holds.

An entry whose durable owed bytes in _cdc_obligations exceed SHIP_MAX_BYTES ships one ordinal per vector with SHIP_RANGE_CUT.BYTES; once committed CDC_DELIVERED acknowledgements reduce its remaining owed bytes within SHIP_MAX_BYTES, the remaining READY ordinals are classified as one whole-entry unit (alone: false) and ship together. All existing ship-unit, ship-window, range-shipping, and range-differential invariants remain green.

firstReadyRow pages owed positions using owedPositionsAfter with BOUND.DRIVE_PAGE_ROWS instead of limit: 1 per row, and drainPendingHydratedObligations reads owed positions via readOwedCdcObligationPositions instead of reading event_json payloads via readOwedCdcObligations.
